translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus e Aecchipwa Aaen Erhai Mwaaen Semwaai
Eew Sabbath Jesus enoa epwe noa mwongo reen imwaen erhai soamwoonin Pharisee; nge aeremas regaen igin pipiiy firhiy.
Erhai mwaaen epwo pirheen me paiun a noa itto reen Jesus,
iwe nge Jesus a kepastae nge a aengaeniir sinsein anniug kkewe me Pharisees kkewe pwe, “Meeta Anniug we aarh e iura sipwe aecchipwaar aeremas wooan Sabbath ngaere aapw?”
Nge iir rese paniuwaeni. Iwe Jesus a paeni mwaaen we, a aecchipwa, nge a aengaeni pwe epwene noa.

Iwe a aengaeniir rhooawe pwe, “Ngaere igine erhai me neeimi eyor naiun wonigaet ngaere wakke nge eppiung nong noan eew rhanniunim wooan Sabbath, oawsoapw taiuw mwetekkaeiwow inamwo raaenin Sabbath miniwe?”
Nge erhai mwo me neeiir nge ese mmwen ngaeni epwe paniuwaeni.
Mesoanosoan me Ttiumwiun
Jesus eweriir aaemweoi me neeiir waseona kkewe re fini pwiuneoi kkewe e igin mwamwaai pwe repwe mooat ee, iwe a fioangei ngaeniir fioangon awewe een.
“Igine erhai epwe aerigirig wopwe noa tapweei eew gupwunon appwiuniupai, wosoapw noa mooat pwiuneoi na e oarosaen mwamwaai. Pwe ina maeni epwe yor erhai ina eyor ipitan me mmwoamw ina epwe noa itto,
nge iyo we e faingigaemi epwe noa itto nge epwene aengaeniug pwe, ‘Merenoa pwe mwaaen een epwe mooat igina.’ Iwe ina een wopwene saew nge wopwene noa mooat tiw pwiuneoi na e oarosaen sessoan.

Ieen minne oawpwe feeori, igine repwe aerigirig, wopwe noa wa noa mooat igina oarosaen sessoan ee, ina nge iyo we e faingiug epwe noa itto reemw nge epwene aengaeniug pwe, ‘Moawwerh maereyaerei, itto mooat iga e mwamwaai e.’ Ieen minne epwene aetaegisoag tae me neeiir aeremas kkena reno pwe een erhai aeremas eyor ipitoamw.
Pwe iyo na e aetaegiasa tae epwe sessoanotiw, nge iyo na epwe oasossonaetiw epwe taegias tae.”

Iwe Jesus a aengaeni iyo we e faingito pwe, “Igine wopwe gaen ffeeor oamw mwongoon oanowas ngaere mwongoon faaef, wosoapw faingiir maereyaeremw ngaere pwiimw ngaere perhaengioamw ngaere iyo kkena aeremesaen weni oaromw igina re naiwiis — pwe ina repwe pwan faingi sefaaeniug pwe wopwe pwan noa tapweer reen gupwun pwe repwe paniuwaeni ngaeniug meeta we wofeeori ngaeniir.
Igine wopwe gaen ffeeor oamw gupwun, faingiir rhooakkena re mwaenene, rhooakkena e mwaetete oanongeer, rhooa mae pirheer, me rhooa parh;

ina nge wopwe wenepwu, pwe iga iir rese mmwen repwe paniuwaeni meeta we wofeeori ngaeniir. Deus epwe paniuwaeni oamw feoffeeor noan raaenin na oanongeer aeremas kena re mwamwaai repwene menaw tae me reen mae.”
Awewen Gupwun Igin Temoag we
Oatowe erhai me neeiir waseona kkewe remooat reen table we e rongorong minikkewe, nge a aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Ifa mwo aar kker rhooakka repwe tapweei gupwun na noan minna Mweoiun Deus!”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Eno erhai mwaaen efeeori eew gupwun igin temoag nge e igin towunap aeremas kka e faingiir.
Igiwe a toori oaton gupwun we nge a fang noa erhai naiun rhooan akkiuneo epwe noa faingiir waseona kkewe, ‘Oaw itto pwe oanongaen meeta nge a oamoannatae!’

Iwe nge erhai me erhai neeiir a ffeeor fetaen mwarhneokkiur. Manewe egommw a aengaeni rhooan akkiuneo we pwe, ‘Ngaang iya chuwaiuw eew maat nge ipwe noa mwo sengaeri; faaen pirhemw nge isoapw mmwenen tapweog.’
Nge iwe erhai a iura pwe, ‘Ngaang inaaen chuwaiur seig wakke nge iye ipwene noa aegina aaei aengaengaar; faaen pirhemw nge isoapw mmwenen tapweog.’
Nge iwe erhai a iura pwe, ‘Ngaang iye inaaen appwiuniupai noa rhag, nge ina faaen minne isoapw mmwenen toowow reen.’

Iwe rhooan akkiuneo we a sefaaen nge a noa aengaeni maasta we aan oanongaen minikkewe re iura. Maasta we a igin soong nge a aengaeni rhooan akkiuneo we pwe, ‘Mwetekkaei wow wooan aan temoag kena me aan mwittig kkomwu ne aepinoamw, nge wa pwigiir to rhooa mwaenene, rhooa mwaetete oanongeer, rhooa parh, me rhooa pirhemae.’
Ese mmwaei mwo nge rhooan akkiuneo we a itto iura pwe, ‘Iya moann aaei feeori meeta kkewe wo iura, nge e rhiuwen nenieer aeremas.’
Iwe maasta we a aengaeni rhooan akkiuneo we naiun pwe, ‘Wonoa itiwow noan ennap me aan paecchig kena enoa niugiun aepinoamw pwe wopwe noa faingiir to aeremas, pwe epwe sseog noa noan iimw we imwaei.
Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe esooar erhai me neeiir rhooawe si mmwaen faingiir ne epwe nnaeri egius me reen mwongoon gupwun e aaei.’ ”
Wunuunun Aaen Erhai Epwe No pwe Rhooan Kkayeo
Eew oat igiwe e igin towunap aeremas re tettapwei Jesus, a wegitaeg nge a aengaeniir pwe,
“Iyo kka re itto reei resoapw mmwenen no pwe naeyi rhooan kkayeo igine rese aerhaengiaei noa memmweer semeer me ineer, rhooan ngaenneer me naiiur, pwiir me mwengeyeer, me iir wooan oanongeer.
Iyo kena rese aiufera aar kurus nge ra itto tapweaei resoapw mmwenen no pwe naeyi rhooan kkayeo.

Ngaere igine erhai me neeimi e niunniuwaennei pwe epwe feeori eew iimw taegias, mesaemmwaen minne wopwe feeori ina wopwe mooat tiw wa aeperha paniuwaen, pwe wopwe giuneei ngaere epwe toaw ngaeniug paniuwaen aan moann ngaeniug engaang na oamw.
Ngaere wose feeori minneei, nge ina esoapw mmwenen moann ngaeniug iimw taegias eei mwirin oamw feeori noa poasopoason; nge oanongeer rhooakkena reweri meeta ewen repwene kekkaei aeginiug.
Nge repwene iura pwe, ‘A rhaepetae oamw kaiu nge ese mmwenen moann ngaeniug oamw engaang!’

Ngaere erhai king e pwigiir seig sengeras sonotaw repwe noa moawun ngaeni pwan erhai king e pwigiir riiuweig sengeras sonotaw, mesaemmwaen ina epwe mooat tiw a niunniuwaennei mwo ngaere epwe mmwenen niir rhooan peig na epeig.
Ngaere esoapw mmwen, iwe epwene fangenoa naiun rhooan akkiuneo reen king na erhai iga e rhiuwen taaw pwe repwe feeori fengaenniy oapoas nepeteer.
Epwe ieei rhag wusun pwe esooar neeimi ne epwe mmwenen no pwe naeyi rhooan kkayeo igine ese oatoranoa oanongaen aegiaeg.”
Aesiig we Ese Saaet
“Aesiig ina e mwamwaai, iwe ngaere esa saaet no, sisoapw mmwenen aesaaeti sefaaeniy.
Ese gacch ngaeni ppweon ngaere koiyas; re aekkaerh noa. Iyo eyor saeningan, epwe rongorong!”
